Extreme weather

Hurricane Season

A hurricane is coming to Puerto Rico. Several plants can lose output at once, and the oil you'll need during repairs gets more expensive.

Play Hurricane Season↗ Your decisions ↓

Choose your difficulty before you start. It’s free to play in your browser.

Location
San Juan, Puerto Rico
Starts in
2000
Your term
20 years

Your starting point

In 2000 you take over an island grid supplied by oil, gas and coal. You have several years before the 2008 hurricane season to decide what San Juan needs.

When the storm hits, some generators will produce less until repairs finish. The loss can be bigger than the spare capacity you'd normally keep for a single plant outage.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Build before landfall

    Compare project completion dates with the storm outlook. New capacity needs to be ready while damaged plants are still under repair.

  2. 02

    Plan for more than one outage

    Look at what the rest of the fleet could supply if several of your generators lost output together.

  3. 03

    Keep a fuel reserve in the budget

    Check how much cash you'll need to keep the oil plants running at the higher price.

How much backup can San Juan afford before the storm?
